name: AgentDojo
description: An extensible evaluation framework and dynamic environment for assessing the adversarial robustness of AI agents executing tools over untrusted data, featuring 97 realistic tasks and 629 security test cases.
reputation: A recent security benchmark/framework that is gaining attention for evaluating tool-using agents against realistic adversarial and untrusted-data scenarios.
notes: Focuses on prompt injection attacks and defenses; environment supports evolving attacks and defenses; includes tasks like managing email clients and e-banking navigation.
